turns.text:
Alright, here's the skinny on that Northgate Retail email:

**What changed:** They split one master switch into three separate toggles — marketing emails, price notices, and delivery updates. So instead of one checkbox controlling all three, you can now mix and match.

**Did they keep your old settings?** Yep — they say your existing choices were carried across unchanged. Whatever you had set before under the single umbrella got mapped to all three switches the same way. So if you were getting marketing emails before, you're still getting them; same for the other two.

**You good as-is or want to tweak any of the three?** If you want a different combo (say, keep delivery updates but ditch the marketing blasts), it's on the account page — just let me know and I can pull it up.
